In mathematics, the '''Carleson–Jacobs theorem''', introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=L. Carleson|authorlink=Lennart Carleson|last2=S. Jacobs|author2-link=Sigvard Jacobs|year=1972}}, describes the best approximation to a [[continuous function]] on the [[unit circle]] by a function in a [[Hardy space]].{{sfn|Garnett|1981|p=139}}
